utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning, all. Monday the ninth, and it's still raining sideways. Anyone actually manage their weekend plans?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Planned a walk. Got as far as the car, saw the weather, went back in. Very successful weekend, really.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good preventative maintenance on your boots.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. I stood beside a football pitch getting soaked. Yours sounds better, Jamie.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Are we all on? Teams says someone's still connecting.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's me twice. Phone's in, laptop's thinking about it. You can hear me, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, you're fine. Right, quick run through what's already finished first.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Already swapped the filter on the tower yesterday. That's done, not something for this morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That was the one showing on the old handover?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, same one. Old entry, finished job.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the GT2 water valve yesterday. That one's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: While we're on old entries, I signed off the inspection on the water ring on Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, yeah? So that's a completed inspection, not one waiting on us.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Signed off. Don't put it back in the pile.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Different thing on the water ring, though. Boss, if you've got a spare minute, can you book a contractor to look at the water ring by 11am?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I can't take that, sorry. I'm tied up on the production side this morning; I'd only end up sitting on it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Is that the booking needed by eleven, rather than someone physically here by eleven?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, the booking. Jamie, can you take that instead—book a contractor to look at the water ring by 11am, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it off boss. I'll book a contractor to look at the water ring by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And just to separate those two things, my inspection being signed off doesn't mean this contractor booking's already done.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Understood. Booking's mine; I'm not reopening your inspection.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. Anything to add on the new starters?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the training records for the new starters. That's in the whenever you get a chance category, but I'll have them ready tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Cheers, boss. Tomorrow at 9:30 for the records, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's it. Not making it a drop-everything job.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Access-wise, we can't get to the Atlas until production gives us a window. Still blocked, no work on that agreed here.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, so it's not secretly available because it's Monday?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sadly not. And we can't get to the desiccant unit until production gives us a window either. Same blocker.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, without a window there's nothing to get into on either of those.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. Just carrying the blockers, not handing either job out today.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: One observation from me: heard a slight rattle from the big valve by the gate, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just a noise you've noticed, not a strip-down request?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Just the observation. Nothing to action yet, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: There's also downtime to schedule with production for the door switch on two. Low priority, needs scheduling by the 28th. That hasn't got an owner.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's agreeing the downtime with production, rather than saying the switch work itself is due then?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. Schedule downtime for the door switch on two with production by the 28th. That's the outstanding bit.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't volunteer for the scheduling side. Don't put my name against it just because I mentioned the handover.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, fair. Nobody's taken that, so it stays unowned. Low priority, but still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: For my bit, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Arburg by the end of the week. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Cheers, Cal. Permit to work and isolation both with you, then?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, both with me for the Arburg. By the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, so that commitment's the permit and isolation, not a general promise that every job on it is finished.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Correct. Let's not accidentally promise the whole factory while we're at it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Pri, can you investigate the pressure drop on the air compressor today at 2pm?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the air compressor today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Investigation, yeah? We're not calling it a failed part at this stage.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, exactly. It's a pressure drop to investigate, not a replacement I've already decided on.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, I was talking over you there. That's what I was going to say—bit early to name a part.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah. Otherwise we end up diagnosing it by committee over a crackly microphone.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: All right. Today at 2pm for that, Pri. Keeping that time as agreed.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, two today.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just checking I followed the water ring bit with the audio cutting out. Completed inspection and a new contractor booking are separate entries?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yes. Inspection signed off on Tuesday, finished. No repeat inspection agreed here.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I've accepted the contractor booking for the water ring, by 11am. That's the live one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And training records for the new starters are mine, tomorrow at 9:30. The whenever you get a chance one, not an urgent escalation.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good. I've got the fairly important permit to work and isolation for the Arburg, by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's clear. Atlas and desiccant unit still blocked, so neither's suddenly appeared on my list.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And my tower filter's finished. Rattle was information only. That's me.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine from quality. Much easier when finished work doesn't keep coming round again.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Like my weekend walk. Still pending, depending on the weather.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not putting a deadline on that. We'd never hit it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: You'd need a production window and a waterproof.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Last thing for clarity: scheduling downtime with production for the door switch on two stays unowned, low priority, by the 28th. Nobody's accepted it in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Thanks, everyone.
